I've reviewed the full implementation code (`core.js`, `store.js`, `server.js`, `app.js`, `index.html`). I have enough to judge every requirement from the code and its behaviour.

Key code-based findings:
- **No bulk-selection UI** (no checkboxes, no bulk endpoints) → REF-BM-20/21 absent.
- **No sort control/param** — list is only newest-first via `unshift`; no way to sort by a key → REF-BM-22 absent.
- **Tag search uses `tag:` not `#tag`** (`/^tag:/i` in lexer; `#` untreated) → REF-BM-14 partial.
- **Tag filtering** only via `tag:` search operator; card tag chips are non-clickable `<span>`s, no tag-select affordance → REF-BM-11 partial.
- **URL not editable** (PATCH ignores `url`, no url field) and **description hidden in normal Edit** (`direct=!duplicate; hidden=direct`) → REF-BM-04 partial; description-after-save gap → REF-BM-03 partial.
- **Notes never rendered** in any view (only raw in edit textarea), no markdown parser → REF-BM-23 partial.
- **"Archive"/"capture" = extracted metadata+paragraphs JSON reader view**, not a single-file HTML snapshot; PDFs are rejected (`!type.includes('text/html')`) → REF-BM-24 partial.
- **No bookmark-archive state, no archive list, no Internet Archive, no bundles, no import/export, no user settings** → REF-BM-25/26/27/28/29/30/31/32 absent.
